_doc: Why a card may show two slugs VIVC files under one number (scripts/audit_grape_identity.py, list `shared`). `pairs` is keyed by the sorted slugs joined with '+'; `countries` holds a rule for every pair on that country's cards. Each entry: {decision: keep, reason, source, verified}. A pair with no entry is `review`: fold it in grape_lexicon.py, correct its VIVC pin, or record here why both names stay. Started 2026-10-25 from the phase H re-grade (Castilla, Larnaka): the folds and pins of that day are in grape_lexicon.py (2026-10-25 block) and raw/vivc/slug_overrides.json.

pt.reason: The IVV cadernos list each casta of the national list as a row of its own (Duriense: "Marufo N", "Mourisco N", "Mourisco Roxo R"; "Barreto N" and "Bragão"; "Jampal B" and "Pinheira Branca"), and VIVC folds several of them as synonyms by DNA. The card follows the regulator's rows; the VIVC bracket says what VIVC holds.
pt.source: IVV cadernos de especificações (IG Duriense, Península de Setúbal, Algarve, Tejo, DOC Douro / Porto …)

graciano+tintilla-de-rota.reason: MAPA's list (RD 684/2026) still carries "Tintilla de Rota (T.)" as an entry beside Graciano; a MAPA draft would make it Graciano's synonym. The lexicon keeps the peninsular Tintilla apart until the decree changes (grape_lexicon.py, `tintilla-de-rota`).
graciano+tintilla-de-rota.source: MAPA, Variedades de uva autorizadas por las CCAA (2026-09-08); modificación RD 1338/2018 (participación pública)

spergola+trbljan.reason: Castelfranco Emilia's register annex lists Mostosa and Spergola as two rows; VIVC files SPERGOLA and TRBLJAN as synonyms of MOSTOSA #8075, and the corpus' canonical slug for #8075 is the Croatian trbljan.
spergola+trbljan.source: MASAF disciplinare Castelfranco Emilia IGT, Allegato (vitigni idonei)
